purpose: A connected west-bank wine workshop courtyard and third bridge that rebalance the northern settlement and close a cross-canal production loop.
hero: six-column open wine hall seen through the east gate

circulation.primary: west water street -> 1.70 m east gate -> stone court -> open wine hall
circulation.loop: tea market -> wine yard -> north bridge -> east weaving district

structure: overlapped land support and continuous west water street
thick split east wall with real gate and solid roof
six hall columns on stone shoes with complete beam ring
solidified gabled hall roof with continuous ridge
eleven-plank bridge with twelve rail posts and three risers per bank
